title: Goblin Slayer
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Manga adaptation of a dark fantasy light novel. A young Priestess's first adventuring party is destroyed by goblins, and she is rescued by Goblin Slayer, a silver-ranked adventurer who survived a goblin massacre of his village as a child and now does nothing but hunt goblins. She joins his party as they take on goblin contracts that other adventurers ignore. Content advisory: the opening and later arcs depict sexual violence by goblins, which has drawn controversy and removals from some stores.
life_message: It holds up relentless, practical diligence in protecting ordinary people from a threat others dismiss.

delivery.evidence: Summaries show the outlook through Goblin Slayer's methodical conduct versus glory-seeking adventurers (to verify).
delivery.note: Its regard for practical protection is carried by the hero's methods and their results rather than by speeches.

winners_losers: Goblin Slayer and his party win by meticulous preparation, and goblins are exterminated without mercy; victims of the goblins suffer heavily. Sympathy goes to practical protectors over glory-seeking adventurers.
